DOWN=np.array([[0.,-1,0],[-1,0,0],[0,0,-1]])
class Controller:
    def __init__(self):
        self.res=r.get_obs(video='none');self.n=self.res.meta['calls'];self.q=np.array(self.res.meta['proprio']['now'][:7]);self.f=.04
    def run(self,A,tag):
        A=np.asarray(A);self.n+=1
        with open(OUT/'actions.jsonl','a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'tag':tag,'actions':A.tolist(),'dt':.1})+'\n')
        self.res=r.submit('joint_position',A,dt=.1,video='none',include_depth=True,note=tag)
        self.res.save(OUT/tag);self.q=np.array(self.res.meta['proprio']['now'][:7])
        print(tag,'steps',self.res.meta['control_steps'],'tcp',self.res.meta['proprio']['now'][16:19], 'fingers',self.res.meta['proprio']['now'][14:16],'done',self.res.done,flush=True)
        if self.res.done: print(self.res.meta);raise SystemExit
    def move(self,pos,rot=DOWN,f=None,seconds=2,tag='move'):
        if f is None:f=self.f
        start=fk(self.q);q=self.q.copy();A=[]
        from scipy.spatial.transform import Slerp
        interp=Slerp([0,1],Rotation.from_matrix([start[:3,:3],rot]))
        N=int(seconds*10)
        for i in range(1,N+1):
            t=i/N;t=t*t*(3-2*t)
            q=ik(start[:3,3]*(1-t)+np.array(pos)*t,interp(t).as_matrix(),q)
            A.append(np.r_[q,f,f])
        A.extend([A[-1]]*8);self.run(A,tag);self.f=f
    def grip(self,f,tag):
        self.run([np.r_[self.q,f,f]]*15,tag);self.f=f

if __name__=='__main__':
    import argparse
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('operation');ap.add_argument('--pos',nargs=3,type=float);ap.add_argument('--f',type=float);ap.add_argument('--seconds',type=float,default=2);ap.add_argument('--tag',default='move');args=ap.parse_args()
    c=Controller()
    if args.operation=='move':c.move(args.pos,f=args.f,seconds=args.seconds,tag=args.tag)
    elif args.operation=='grip':c.grip(args.f,args.tag)
    elif args.operation=='observe':observe(args.tag)
